segments.normalizedSource: Use the grammar to create roles, declare record types and their permissions, as well as specify data types and options for each field in the record.
segments.contextBefore: The grammar for the CloudKit Schema Language contains all the elements to define your schema.
segments.contextAfter:
```other
create-schema:
    DEFINE SCHEMA 
        [ { create-role | record-type } ";" ] ...

create-role:
    CREATE ROLE %role-name% 
    
record-type:
    RECORD TYPE %type-name% ( 
        {
            [ %field-name% data-type [ field-options [..] ] ]
            |
            [ GRANT { READ | CREATE | WRITE } [, ... ] TO %role-name% ]
        } ["," ... ]
    )    

field-options:
    | QUERYABLE
    | SORTABLE
    | SEARCHABLE

data-type:
   primitive-type | list-type

primitive-type:
   | ASSET
   | BYTES
   | DOUBLE
   | [ ENCRYPTED ] { BYTES | STRING | DOUBLE | INT64 | LOCATION | TIMESTAMP }
   | INT64
   | LOCATION 
   | NUMBER [ PREFERRED AS { INT64 | DOUBLE } ]
   | REFERENCE
   | STRING
   | TIMESTAMP
   
list-type:
   | LIST "<" primitive-type ">"


```

segments.contextBefore: This sample schema defines a simple company department and employee information.
segments.contextAfter:
```other
DEFINE SCHEMA
    CREATE ROLE DeptManager;

    RECORD TYPE Department (
        "___createTime" TIMESTAMP QUERYABLE SORTABLE,
        "___recordID" REFERENCE QUERYABLE,
        name STRING,
        address STRING,
        phone LIST<STRING>,
        employees LIST<REFERENCE>,
        GRANT WRITE TO "_creator", 
        GRANT CREATE TO "_icloud",
        GRANT READ TO "_world",
        GRANT WRITE, CREATE, READ TO DeptManager
    );

    RECORD TYPE Employee (
        "___createTime" TIMESTAMP QUERYABLE SORTABLE,
        "___recordID" REFERENCE QUERYABLE,
        name STRING,
        address STRING,
        hiredate TIMESTAMP,
        salary INT64,
        GRANT WRITE TO "_creator", 
        GRANT CREATE TO "_icloud",
        GRANT READ TO "_world"
    );
```
